sections.section_title: RCC APB1 peripheral low reset register (RCC_APB1LRSTR)
sections.text_helper: Section 9.8.11 "RCC APB1 peripheral low reset register (RCC_APB1LRSTR)" in chapter 9 (Reset and clock control (RCC)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 291.
sections.section_content:

Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bit 31 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
